Interface DbSupport

All Known Implementing Classes:
DbSupportBase, H2DbSupport
public interface DbSupport
Database specific operations and access mechanisms. An implementation manages and uses a sharedConnection, See SsUtils.dbSupport() for best access method.

  • Method Details

    • getSharedConnection

      Connection getSharedConnection() throws SQLException
      Return an open connection for quick use that connects to the database where the row set comes from. Do not close the returned connection after use. Using this to create a ResultSet/JdbcRowSet that stays open is not quick.
      Returns:
      connection, may be null
      Throws:
      SQLException

    • createRownumQuery

      default String createRownumQuery(String selectColumns, String rownumberColumn, String tableName, String trailingClause)
      Create a query that contains the row number of a non "order by" query. When used in conjunction with a SsDbComboBox2 which is acting as a combobox navigator, the row number is used to avoid sequential searches table searches in SyncManager. For example, given 
      sup.createRownumQuery("part_id, part_name",
                      "rown",
                      "part_data",
                      "ORDER BY part_name");
      The H2 DbSupport uses the the H2 builtin function ROWNUM() and returns the string 
      SELECT part_id, part_name, ROWNUM() AS rown
FROM part_data
ORDER BY part_name;

      Note that Mariadb has ROWNUM() and Oracle has ROWNUM; they perform a similar function. Other databases use ROW_NUMBER() in more complex windowed queries, example fragment of a more complex query: 

      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))
      refer to your database documentation, or AI assistant, for implementing this method.
      Parameters:
      selectColumns - could be "*"
      rownumberColumn -
      tableName -
      trailingClause - for example "ORDER BY someCol"
      Returns:
      query or null

    • resolveArrayElementType

      default JDBCType resolveArrayElementType(ResultSetMetaData rmd, int columnIndex) throws SQLException
      Examine the specified JDBCType.ARRAY's columns metadata, and return the array's element type. See H2DbSupport for a database specific example that should also work with HSQLDB and DuckDB. Best to provide a DB specific implementation.

      This default implementation is based on Google search AI. The AI claims this works with PostgreSQL, H2, HSQLDB, ClickHouse, MySQL/TiDB, Oracle, DuckDB, and SQL Server.

      Parameters:
      rmd -
      columnIndex -
      Returns:
      Throws:
      SQLException
